model.label: GPT-6 Astra
model.trainingSetting: Frozen per-task in-context preparation; no weight updates

protocolChanges: Full/unseen only; 3 episodes per task rather than the 50-episode reference.
Fixed indices 5–7 are nested within the 1× cohort; 23 valid original outcomes were carried forward and 55 timeout failures were extended.
Extensions replay the original action prefix in a reinitialized simulator; endpoint restoration is approximate, with documented boundary validation.

aggregation.efficiency: expert_time_step / mean successful steps_to_stable_success. Pool successful episodes across all four channels before calculating task mean efficiency. Overall values average task efficiencies over tasks with success; report valid-task counts.

aggregation.scope: Overall channel aggregates require all 26 settings. Four-channel means require all four channels. Never substitute Full-only scores for means or include duplicate reruns.

protocol.protocolChanges: Task-specific Mora V0 checkpoints chosen retrospectively on recorded evaluation success. All four channels use the same selected checkpoint per task. protocol.runtimeSnapshot: Evaluation snapshot recorded on 2026-10-19; scene metric contents and hashes attached
protocol.expertReference: All 26 recorded expert_time_step values match the checked official scene snapshot.
protocolChanges: Task09 stage metrics use an axis-corrected offline replay of saved 20 Hz states; SR and other online outcomes are retained. Original online metric frequency was 60 Hz.
Task27 retains the 2026-10-19 object_inside/tolerance=0.22 predicates; the checked current release uses container-local zone predicates for stages, terminal success and drop diagnostics.
Task42 retains stage order banana peel -> paper -> bottle; the checked current release uses paper -> bottle -> banana peel. These historical results were not rescored.

aggregation.missing: No-success efficiency is null; overall efficiency reports its valid-task count.

model.label: PyRUA-Dex
model.inputs: RGB cameras + proprioception + tactile + camera calibration + task description with goal text
model.trainingSetting: No human demonstration data and no weight updates: coding agents write and test controller programs on development layouts (seeds disjoint from the evaluation seeds); the best program per task is frozen
model.evaluationSetting: One frozen program per task; 26 tasks x 4 channels x 50 episodes; no language-model calls during evaluation

executionStepBudget.rule: 3 * ceil(1.5 * expert_time_step / 3) physics steps (the benchmark's own episode limit, 1x)

protocol.expertReference: paper-expert-reference (expert_time_step of the scene files at the benchmark commit)
protocolChanges: Method: one frozen program per task, written and tested by GPT-6 Astra coding agents on development layouts (seeds disjoint from the evaluation seeds, with the simulator's stage feedback). No human demonstration data, no trained weights, no language-model calls during evaluation.
Task description: the benchmark's instruction together with a goal text saying in words what completing the task means.

Inputs at evaluation: besides RGB cameras, joint positions and tactile, the program uses the episode's camera calibration, forward kinematics and a segmentation model (SAM3); no simulator state or success/stage signals.

model.label: GigaWorld-Policy-0.6
model.evaluationSetting: 26 tasks, four channels, 50 episodes per task/channel; fixed checkpoint across all tasks

protocol.expertReference: Native per-episode expert_time_step, in physics steps.
protocol.protocolChanges: Custom GWP model integration and Drive v5 IK/execution adapter; robot_base EEF80 actions; prediction/execution horizon 32. Native physics budgets, seeds and stable-success dwell recorded in logs. All 60 scored IK failures remain in denominators; no scored episodes replaced. Native shards were merged into 50-episode task/channel outputs for the original submission export. Exact historical worker benchmark commits are not asserted.

aggregation.errors: All 60 scored IK errors retained; 5200 episodes, 2671 successes.

model.label: UniTacWAM
model.inputs: RGB + proprioception + tactile + action history + task instruction
model.trainingSetting: Unified visuo-tactile world action model (one model for parallel grippers and dexterous hands, unified action space). Multi-task fine-tuned from a pretrained foundation model on all 26 tasks: 5 window epochs, global batch 640, LR 1e-4 cosine; single checkpoint step 25738
model.evaluationSetting: 26 tasks, four channels, 50 episodes per task/channel; fixed checkpoint across all tasks; IK: default bridge IK, GWP-style IK on the 11 tasks with 7-DoF arms (03 09 22 26 32 51 61 62 64 73 79)

protocol.expertReference: Native per-episode expert_time_step, in physics steps.
protocol.protocolChanges: UniTacWAM policy server + Bench2Dex policy bridge (absolute EEF targets in robot base -> IK). One checkpoint for all 26 tasks. IK: default bridge IK on 15 tasks; on the 11 tasks with 7-DoF arms (03 09 22 26 32 51 61 62 64 73 79) the bridge IK runs in a GWP-style mode (joint-limit preference + re-solve on large joint jumps). Native physics budgets, seeds and stable-success dwell recorded in logs. Episodes interrupted by infrastructure were resumed with the same seeds; no scored episode replaced; all failures kept in the denominators.

model.label: WorldScape Policy 2.5-Preview
model.inputs: Overhead and wrist RGB, robot joint positions, and task instruction
model.trainingSetting: One 60,000-step multitask checkpoint trained across all 26 Bench2Dex tasks.
model.evaluationSetting: 26 tasks, four channels, 50 episodes per task/channel; fixed checkpoint; 60 Hz physics and 20 Hz policy control.

protocol.expertReference: Native per-episode expert_time_step in physics steps.
protocol.protocolChanges: The evaluator adds a remote WSP2 bridge for joint-position control, overhead and wrist RGB, and scene-level language instructions. GPU simulation ran with PhysX continuous collision detection (CCD) disabled. The xArm7 + Ability setup uses the enabled colliders authored in the robot USD. Local runtime changes also adjust camera resource cleanup and RPC framing. None, Equi., and Inv. use replay anchors, and Full samples initial states without replay anchors. Each task/channel runs in two 25-episode batches appended to the same native log.

aggregation.sr: Stable successes divided by scored episodes, averaged equally across channels and tasks.
aggregation.lscr: Mean native latched stage completion rate including failures, averaged equally across channels and tasks.
aggregation.efficiency: Per-task expert steps divided by mean steps over all successful episodes pooled across channels, then averaged across eligible tasks.
aggregation.errors: All 5,200 scored episodes retained, including failures. The native summaries report zero error episodes.
